purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Kisii

queries.query: Kenya official cadastral parcel map viewer Kisii land registry GIS
queries.result: First-party results identified the State Department for Lands Kisii lands office and the Kisii County Lands, Physical Planning, Housing and Urban Development department. The official Ardhisasa portal was identified as the national public land-information portal, but no anonymous parcel feature response was exposed.

queries.query: Kenya Kisii ramani ya viwanja kadastri usajili wa ardhi rasmi
queries.result: First-party Swahili-language results identified the Ministry service charter and Ardhisasa land-information portal. The charter describes RIM/mutation maps and land-search services, but no anonymous Kisii parcel map/API or safe ID+geometry response was exposed.

registryEvidence.custodian: Kisii County Government Lands, Physical Planning, Housing and Urban Development department locally, and the State Department for Lands Kisii lands office nationally.
registryEvidence.locality: The official Kisii County page identifies local Lands and Survey and Mapping functions, including custody of land records, land registration support, cadastral survey grid control, survey-record maintenance and beacon re-establishment. The State Department directory lists the Kisii lands office in the County Commissioner's Compound in Kisii Town with land registration, administration, valuation and survey/mapping functions.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: This establishes local and national land/cadastre custodianship, not public parcel-data availability, citywide coverage, currentness or legal title coverage.

boundedResponse.interpretation: The public service metadata extent is approximately 39.43–39.71E, -0.0095–0.2814N, far from Kisii; the empty point query is therefore a map-extent miss, not evidence of parcel absence.

parcelDiscovery.note: Ardhisasa HTML and its current main JavaScript were inspected. The site exposes the official land-information workflow and an Ardhisasa API host, but no anonymous public parcel map/API route, schema, CRS or safe ID+geometry response was available without authentication. No GeoJSON was retained. A separate public WWF Kenya ArcGIS parcel-area service was queried only with safe ID-like and geometry fields; its documented extent does not cover Kisii.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official Kisii County department page retrieved; it evidences local land-record custody, land registration, survey and mapping functions and publishes the department contact, but no public parcel layer or feature API.
Official State Department directory identified Kisii lands office and its registration, administration, valuation and survey/mapping services; no public parcel geometry endpoint.
Official Ardhisasa portal retrieved; current HTML exposed JavaScript bundles and a public land-information entry point, but no anonymous parcel feature response.
Official FAQ retrieved; it defines cadastral maps and parcels and describes land-information services, but does not expose a safe anonymous parcel layer.
Official terms retrieved; it defines cadastral-map and parcel concepts, but no public schema or geometry service was exposed.
Official Swahili service charter retrieved; it describes RIM/mutation maps and land-search procedures, but not a public anonymous parcel API.
The API host referenced by the current JavaScript returned HTTP 404 at its root; no endpoint was guessed or authenticated.
Public non-government ArcGIS service metadata retrieved: WGS84/4326, layer Plots, safe fields FID/OID_/Name/Area_Ha/Area_Acre, documented extent outside Kisii.
Anonymous safe point query returned an empty FeatureCollection; because the service extent excludes Kisii, this is recorded as an extent miss, not citywide absence.

uncertainty: The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and never shifted.
The Ardhisasa public workflow may contain additional authenticated land records, but no login, account creation, private token or unsafe field request was attempted.
The WWF Kenya query's zero result is an extent miss and is not evidence of citywide parcel absence; it is not treated as a first-party Kenyan government registry source.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, certificate or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
